item.description: New: Settings list the permissions Bolo holds and what each is for, and the first run asks for each, with Not Now on the optional ones. Fixed: Check for Updates… says when a newer version is ready, and the update window comes to the front.

New: Bolo can keep your recordings (Keep Recordings in Settings), and they follow you to a new Mac in your settings folder. New: The card shows the version. New: Bolo tidies your words on your Mac when Claude can't, such as with no internet or in Epic. Turn on Tidy on This Mac in Settings; it downloads 2.7 GB once. Better: The pill's bars move with your voice in any room, even when you speak quietly. Better: Each dictation shows its app's icon level with its words, and the Dictionary says Delete. Better: Claude and your Mac tidy to your style card: Dr., 7:30 AM, December 9, and 5 mg in Epic. Fixed: Bolo hears a quiet voice through AirPods or any microphone you choose, and Settings lists only real ones. Fixed: If Claude answers late, Bolo keeps the tidied text so you can paste it. To try: Set Tidy on This Mac to When Claude Can't in Settings, Claude. Once it has downloaded, turn off Wi-Fi and dictate with an um. It should land tidied. To try: Dictate a line in Epic. It should land tidied, as a note.
